texto: Trigger a URL elicitation so the client can direct the user to a browser flow. Supports two mechanisms: the request path (elicitation/create, default) which awaits the user's response, and the error path (UrlElicitationRequiredError, -32042) which signals the client to handle URL elicitation via the error response. Set errorPath=true to use the error path. On protocol version 2026-07-28 the server instead returns the URL elicitation in-band (input_required).
